author: Fextralife
description:
Solasta 2 CHARACTER CREATION Reveal & Classes (Early Access)
In this Fextralife video, we're going to be talking a look at Solasta 2 character creator and the character creation that will be present in the early access version of Solasta 2 that comes out in just a few weeks on March 12th. This is another game that I am super hyped for. This is a game that has upgraded its presentation, not only visually which you'll see in the footage in this video, but it's added some dynamic personalities to it's cast, including Ben Starr and Amelia Tyler. So it has alot more production value than the previous game, and I think a lot of people still has this game flying under their radar when they really should be looking out for it.
